Title: Preview all employees
SQL: SELECT TOP (20) * FROM dbo.HR_Employees;

Title: Total employee count
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalEmployees FROM dbo.HR_Employees;

Title: Attrition count and percentage
SQL: SELECT Attrition, COUNT(*) AS Employees, CAST(100.0*COUNT(*)/SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER() AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS EmployeePct FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY Attrition;

Title: Department headcount
SQL: SELECT Department, COUNT(*) AS Headcount FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY Department ORDER BY Headcount DESC;

Title: Average salary by department
SQL: SELECT Department, AVG(MonthlyIncome) AS AvgMonthlyIncome FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY Department ORDER BY AvgMonthlyIncome DESC;

Title: Attrition by department
SQL: SELECT Department, COUNT(*) AS Headcount, SUM(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AttritionCount, CAST(100.0*AVG(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS AttritionRatePct FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY Department ORDER BY AttritionRatePct DESC;

Title: Attrition by gender
SQL: SELECT Gender, COUNT(*) AS Headcount, SUM(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Leavers FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY Gender;

Title: Attrition by marital status
SQL: SELECT MaritalStatus, COUNT(*) AS Headcount, AVG(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100 AS AttritionRatePct FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY MaritalStatus;

Title: Attrition by business travel
SQL: SELECT BusinessTravel, COUNT(*) AS Headcount, AVG(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100 AS AttritionRatePct FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY BusinessTravel;

Title: Overtime and attrition
SQL: SELECT OverTime, COUNT(*) AS Headcount, AVG(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100 AS AttritionRatePct FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY OverTime;

Title: Average age by attrition
SQL: SELECT Attrition, AVG(CAST(Age AS FLOAT)) AS AvgAge FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY Attrition;

Title: Attrition by age band
SQL: SELECT CASE WHEN Age<26 THEN '18-25' WHEN Age<36 THEN '26-35' WHEN Age<46 THEN '36-45' WHEN Age<56 THEN '46-55' ELSE '56-60' END AS AgeBand, COUNT(*) AS Employees, AVG(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100 AS AttritionRatePct FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY CASE WHEN Age<26 THEN '18-25' WHEN Age<36 THEN '26-35' WHEN Age<46 THEN '36-45' WHEN Age<56 THEN '46-55' ELSE '56-60' END ORDER BY AgeBand;

Title: Average tenure by attrition
SQL: SELECT Attrition, AVG(CAST(YearsAtCompany AS FLOAT)) AS AvgYearsAtCompany FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY Attrition;

Title: Employees with short tenure
SQL: SELECT TOP (25) EmployeeNumber, Age, Department, JobRole, YearsAtCompany, Attrition FROM dbo.HR_Employees WHERE YearsAtCompany<=2 ORDER BY YearsAtCompany, Age;

Title: High earners
SQL: SELECT TOP (20) EmployeeNumber, Department, JobRole, MonthlyIncome FROM dbo.HR_Employees ORDER BY MonthlyIncome DESC;

Title: Salary bands
SQL: SELECT CASE WHEN MonthlyIncome<3000 THEN 'Under 3k' WHEN MonthlyIncome<6000 THEN '3k-5,999' WHEN MonthlyIncome<10000 THEN '6k-9,999' ELSE '10k+' END AS SalaryBand, COUNT(*) AS Employees, AVG(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100 AS AttritionRatePct FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY CASE WHEN MonthlyIncome<3000 THEN 'Under 3k' WHEN MonthlyIncome<6000 THEN '3k-5,999' WHEN MonthlyIncome<10000 THEN '6k-9,999' ELSE '10k+' END;

Title: Attrition by job role
SQL: SELECT JobRole, COUNT(*) AS Employees, SUM(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Leavers, AVG(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100 AS AttritionRatePct FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY JobRole ORDER BY AttritionRatePct DESC;

Title: Job satisfaction and attrition
SQL: SELECT JobSatisfaction, COUNT(*) AS Employees, AVG(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100 AS AttritionRatePct FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY JobSatisfaction ORDER BY JobSatisfaction;

Title: Environment satisfaction and attrition
SQL: SELECT EnvironmentSatisfaction, COUNT(*) AS Employees, AVG(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100 AS AttritionRatePct FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY EnvironmentSatisfaction ORDER BY EnvironmentSatisfaction;

Title: Work-life balance and attrition
SQL: SELECT WorkLifeBalance, COUNT(*) AS Employees, AVG(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100 AS AttritionRatePct FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY WorkLifeBalance ORDER BY WorkLifeBalance;

Title: Education field distribution
SQL: SELECT EducationField, COUNT(*) AS Employees FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY EducationField ORDER BY Employees DESC;

Title: Education level and salary
SQL: SELECT Education, COUNT(*) AS Employees, AVG(MonthlyIncome) AS AvgMonthlyIncome FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY Education ORDER BY Education;

Title: Promotion delay
SQL: SELECT TOP (20) EmployeeNumber, Department, JobRole, YearsAtCompany, YearsSinceLastPromotion FROM dbo.HR_Employees ORDER BY YearsSinceLastPromotion DESC;

Title: Manager tenure and attrition
SQL: SELECT CASE WHEN YearsWithCurrManager<=1 THEN '0-1' WHEN YearsWithCurrManager<=3 THEN '2-3' WHEN YearsWithCurrManager<=6 THEN '4-6' ELSE '7+' END AS ManagerTenureBand, COUNT(*) AS Employees, AVG(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100 AS AttritionRatePct FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY CASE WHEN YearsWithCurrManager<=1 THEN '0-1' WHEN YearsWithCurrManager<=3 THEN '2-3' WHEN YearsWithCurrManager<=6 THEN '4-6' ELSE '7+' END;

Title: Companies worked and attrition
SQL: SELECT NumCompaniesWorked, COUNT(*) AS Employees, AVG(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100 AS AttritionRatePct FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY NumCompaniesWorked ORDER BY NumCompaniesWorked;

Title: Training frequency and attrition
SQL: SELECT TrainingTimesLastYear, COUNT(*) AS Employees, AVG(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100 AS AttritionRatePct FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY TrainingTimesLastYear ORDER BY TrainingTimesLastYear;

Title: Performance rating distribution
SQL: SELECT PerformanceRating, COUNT(*) AS Employees FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY PerformanceRating ORDER BY PerformanceRating;

Title: Salary hike by attrition
SQL: SELECT Attrition, AVG(PercentSalaryHike) AS AvgSalaryHikePct FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY Attrition;

Title: Distance from home and attrition
SQL: SELECT CASE WHEN DistanceFromHome<=5 THEN '0-5' WHEN DistanceFromHome<=10 THEN '6-10' WHEN DistanceFromHome<=20 THEN '11-20' ELSE '21-29' END AS DistanceBand, COUNT(*) AS Employees, AVG(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100 AS AttritionRatePct FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY CASE WHEN DistanceFromHome<=5 THEN '0-5' WHEN DistanceFromHome<=10 THEN '6-10' WHEN DistanceFromHome<=20 THEN '11-20' ELSE '21-29' END;

Title: Top 10 departments and roles by headcount
SQL: SELECT TOP (10) Department, JobRole, COUNT(*) AS Employees FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY Department, JobRole ORDER BY Employees DESC;

Title: CTE: department attrition summary
SQL: WITH Dept AS (SELECT Department, COUNT(*) AS Headcount, SUM(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Leavers FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY Department) SELECT Department, Headcount, Leavers, CAST(100.0*Leavers/Headcount AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS AttritionRatePct FROM Dept ORDER BY AttritionRatePct DESC;

Title: CTE: employees above department average salary
SQL: WITH DeptAvg AS (SELECT Department, AVG(MonthlyIncome) AS AvgIncome FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY Department) SELECT e.EmployeeNumber,e.Department,e.JobRole,e.MonthlyIncome,d.AvgIncome FROM dbo.HR_Employees e JOIN DeptAvg d ON e.Department=d.Department WHERE e.MonthlyIncome>d.AvgIncome ORDER BY e.Department,e.MonthlyIncome DESC;

Title: CTE: attrition by satisfaction group
SQL: WITH S AS (SELECT JobSatisfaction, COUNT(*) AS Employees, SUM(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Leavers FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY JobSatisfaction) SELECT *, CAST(100.0*Leavers/Employees AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS AttritionRatePct FROM S;

Title: CTE: tenure cohorts
SQL: WITH Cohort AS (SELECT CASE WHEN YearsAtCompany<2 THEN 'Less than 2' WHEN YearsAtCompany<5 THEN '2-4' WHEN YearsAtCompany<10 THEN '5-9' ELSE '10+' END AS TenureGroup, Attrition FROM dbo.HR_Employees) SELECT TenureGroup,COUNT(*) AS Employees,AVG(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100 AS AttritionRatePct FROM Cohort GROUP BY TenureGroup;

Title: CTE: overtime cohort
SQL: WITH OT AS (SELECT OverTime, COUNT(*) AS Employees, SUM(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Leavers FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY OverTime) SELECT *,CAST(100.0*Leavers/Employees AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS AttritionRatePct FROM OT;

Title: ROW_NUMBER: salary ranking within department
SQL: SELECT EmployeeNumber,Department,JobRole,MonthlyIncome,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY Department ORDER BY MonthlyIncome DESC) AS SalaryRank FROM dbo.HR_Employees;

Title: RANK: salary ranking by job role
SQL: SELECT EmployeeNumber,JobRole,MonthlyIncome,RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY JobRole ORDER BY MonthlyIncome DESC) AS RoleSalaryRank FROM dbo.HR_Employees;

Title: DENSE_RANK: tenure ranking
SQL: SELECT EmployeeNumber,Department,YearsAtCompany,DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY YearsAtCompany DESC) AS TenureRank FROM dbo.HR_Employees;

Title: NTILE: salary quartiles
SQL: SELECT EmployeeNumber,MonthlyIncome,NTILE(4) OVER(ORDER BY MonthlyIncome) AS SalaryQuartile FROM dbo.HR_Employees;

Title: LAG: compare salary with previous employee in role
SQL: SELECT EmployeeNumber,JobRole,MonthlyIncome,LAG(MonthlyIncome) OVER(PARTITION BY JobRole ORDER BY EmployeeNumber) AS PreviousSalary FROM dbo.HR_Employees;

Title: LEAD: next salary in department
SQL: SELECT EmployeeNumber,Department,MonthlyIncome,LEAD(MonthlyIncome) OVER(PARTITION BY Department ORDER BY EmployeeNumber) AS NextSalary FROM dbo.HR_Employees;

Title: Running average salary by employee number
SQL: SELECT EmployeeNumber,MonthlyIncome,AVG(MonthlyIncome) OVER(ORDER BY EmployeeNumber ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS RunningAvgIncome FROM dbo.HR_Employees;

Title: Department share of total workforce
SQL: SELECT Department,COUNT(*) AS Employees,100.0*COUNT(*)/SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER() AS WorkforceSharePct FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY Department;

Title: Department attrition rate vs company rate
SQL: WITH X AS (SELECT Department,AVG(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100 AS DeptRate FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY Department), G AS (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100 AS OverallRate FROM dbo.HR_Employees) SELECT Department,DeptRate,OverallRate,DeptRate-OverallRate AS GapPctPoints FROM X CROSS JOIN G ORDER BY GapPctPoints DESC;

Title: Employees with high income and overtime
SQL: SELECT EmployeeNumber,Department,JobRole,MonthlyIncome,OverTime,Attrition FROM dbo.HR_Employees WHERE MonthlyIncome>(SELECT AVG(MonthlyIncome) FROM dbo.HR_Employees) AND OverTime='Yes' ORDER BY MonthlyIncome DESC;

Title: Create attrition view
SQL: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_HR_AttritionSummary AS SELECT Department,JobRole,COUNT(*) AS Employees,SUM(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Leavers,AVG(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)*100 AS AttritionRatePct FROM dbo.HR_Employees GROUP BY Department,JobRole;

Title: Query attrition view
SQL: SELECT * FROM dbo.vw_HR_AttritionSummary ORDER BY AttritionRatePct DESC;

Title: Stored procedure: department summary
SQL: CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.usp_DepartmentSummary @Department VARCHAR(100)=NULL AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; SELECT Department,COUNT(*) AS Employees,SUM(CASE WHEN Attrition='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Leavers,AVG(MonthlyIncome) AS AvgMonthlyIncome FROM dbo.HR_Employees WHERE @Department IS NULL OR Department=@Department GROUP BY Department; END;

Title: Execute stored procedure
SQL: EXEC dbo.usp_DepartmentSummary @Department='Sales';

Title: Data quality validation checks
SQL: SELECT 'Rows' AS CheckName,COUNT(*) AS Result FROM dbo.HR_Employees UNION ALL SELECT 'Null EmployeeNumber',COUNT(*) FROM dbo.HR_Employees WHERE EmployeeNumber IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'Invalid Age',COUNT(*) FROM dbo.HR_Employees WHERE Age<18 OR Age>65 UNION ALL SELECT 'Negative Income',COUNT(*) FROM dbo.HR_Employees WHERE MonthlyIncome<0;
